referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This inventory comprises the construction and disposal of the world biggest port in Rotterdam. The inventory calls processes of material production, representing the material used in the construction phase of the port. Also building activities, and electricty consumption are accounted for (construction and disposal). Emission of NMVOC are included. Also lorry transport of materials to the constructions site has been taken into account. Expenditures due to construction and disposal are addressed.
